name: Aina Leminen
source:
A foreign student from Finland who loves Japanese anime and manga.
With a bright and carefree personality, she quickly adapted to life in Japan.

She expresses her emotions clearly and is the type to speak her mind openly.
She never changes what she believes to be right, but is honest enough to apologize when she feels she is wrong.

Although she is pure Finnish,
she loves Japanese anime and has been watching it since she was little,
and as a result, she can speak Japanese fluently.

Her playing is just as free-spirited as her personality, and she often leads her friends around during ensembles.
She is a genius, and she balances her playing to the very limit without ruining the performance.
She lives alone in an apartment, and her room is filled with love for anime.

In the future, she aims to become a professional viola player.

While essentially identical to [url=/c83765]another version[/url] of herself, the main difference is that this version exists in a timeline where the plot of the [url=/v25719]main series title[/url] did not unfold.
